areas.t: Friday, November 6 and Saturday, November 7: Moderate and gusty northwesterly winds behind a departing cold front will carry clean, cool air into the Mahoning Valley. Furthermore, day-to-day pollutant carryover will be low. Therefore, AQI levels will be Good on both days.   Sunday, moderate and gust

Current Conditions (Friday afternoon, 11/6/2026): A reinforcing cold front is crossing through western Pennsylvania this afternoon, bringing a shifting wind direction out of the northwest and isolated showers. The change in wind is creating good air quality for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) today.
